universities.name: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology
universities.overview:
Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology (NUIST) is a public university in Nanjing, Jiangsu, with a distinctive focus on atmospheric science and meteorology. Its academic choices also span computer science, artificial intelligence, electronic engineering, environmental science, business and languages, giving students several ways to connect their interests with a specialist research environment.

Study at NUIST through undergraduate, master’s, doctoral and Chinese-language options, with English- and Chinese-medium routes across the catalogue. Compare NUIST majors, fees and scholarships to build a study plan around your academic background, preferred teaching language and budget. Scholarship coverage and eligibility depend on the chosen award and programme.

programs.name: Atmospheric Science
programs.deadline: 31 May 2026 (closed; self-funded and university scholarship routes)
qualifications: Non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health.
Strong academic record; comply with Chinese law and university regulations.
High-school diploma and below age 25.

Valid China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) results are required. English science, engineering and agriculture routes require Mathematics and Physics; English humanities, economics and management require Mathematics. Chinese-medium routes also require Academic Chinese (science or arts track); chemistry/materials fields use Chemistry instead of Physics. Confirm the subjects for the chosen major.

Chinese-medium route: HSK Level 4 with 210+ in the 2026 brochure.
documents: Passport photo-page copy, with validity covering the study period.
Passport-sized photograph taken within six months.

Notarised academic transcripts; use Chinese or English, with notarised translations for other languages.
Language qualification certificate for the chosen teaching language.
Study plan or research proposal in Chinese or English.
Foreigner Physical Examination Form, fully completed with the doctor’s signature, hospital seal and sealed photograph; the results are valid for six months.
Bank statement in the applicant’s, parent’s or guardian’s name.
Non-criminal record.
Legal-guardian documents in China if the applicant is under 18.
Valid CSCA certificate for the required subjects.
